Contribution: Formulated the heliocentric model of the universe placing the Sun at its center.
Formulated the laws of planetary motion.
Made original contributions to the science of motion through experimental and mathematical methods and made early telescopic discoveries.
Discovered infrared radiation and the planet Uranus.
Demonstrated that the universe is expanding (Hubble's law).
Formalised binomial nomenclature, the modern system of naming organisms.
Developed the theory of evolution by natural selection.
Discovered the principles of vaccination, microbial fermentation, and pasteurization.
Founded the modern science of genetics through his pea-plant experiments.
Co-deciphered (with James Watson) the double-helix structure of the DNA molecule in 1953.
Discovered the role of oxygen in combustion and is credited with founding modern chemistry.
Laid the foundations of modern atomic theory and stoichiometric chemistry.
Formulated the periodic law and created an early version of the periodic table.
Discovered the elements polonium and radium, pioneering research on radioactivity.
Elucidated the nature of the chemical bond and the structure of complex substances.
Authored the Elements treatise, establishing the foundations of geometry.
Founded graph theory and topology and is regarded as the most prolific mathematician of the 18th century.
Proved the fundamental theorem of algebra and contributed broadly across number theory and differential geometry.
Founded Riemannian geometry which later provided the mathematical framework for general relativity.
Developed the foundations of modern mathematics, including invariant theory and the axiomatization of geometry.
Formulated the laws of motion and universal gravitation, achieving the first great unification in physics.
Discovered electromagnetic induction, diamagnetism, and the laws of electrolysis.
Formulated the classical theory of electromagnetic radiation, unifying electricity, magnetism, and light.
Developed the theory of relativity (special and general).
Made foundational contributions to understanding atomic structure and quantum theory (Bohr model of the atom).
